title: A persisted judgment dated 2099 is rejected under RJ06 every run and does not move now*, so the clock-dependent debt row still reads 51 days

assert.why: A.7.5.1 rule 5: the only obligation is debt
A.12.6 RJ06: the persisted judgment's time (2099) is after now*; it re-applies to persisted records every run (A.6.1.3)
envelopes of one statement are one record (A.5.1.1); it is listed once
A.5.4.3: the rejected record has no force, so missing; Req does not meet Δcode (only README changed), so not introduced (A.7.3.3); matched by GuardWaived, so debt (rule 5, A.4.6.6)

A.6.1.3: now* = max(now, base committer time) is not moved by the 2099 record, so the exception (expires 2026-12-15) is active and expiresInDays = ceil((expires - now*)/86400) = 51 (A.7.7.1, A.12.10.6); owner is the exception's (A.15.7)
the judgment is usable and the law Sat
RJ06 does not apply to a time before now*
A.5.3.7: a usable eligible judgment establishes the informal law
A.4.6.9: the exception matches nothing and is inert
